## Description (from file header)

GrooveDepthGateHook — LATHE-PRO-MS4b Forge-Triple hook.Safety gate on grooving / parting geometry + tool setup. Blocksoperations that exceed physics safety margins:  1. Blade L/t ratio > 10 (overhang / blade thickness) → chatter risk.  2. Peak blade stress > 50% of blade yield (HSS-Co 800 MPa default) → feed too high.  3. Groove depth/width > 6 without peck cycle → chip evacuation failure.  4. Blade width > groove width → impossible single-plunge cut.The hook delegates physics to GrooveCl
